name: Article 1, § 1 – 19
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste
part_text: The application of Article 56(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 shall be suspended, as regards producers established in the Union qualifying as microenterprises, small or medium enterprises, meaning those with fewer than 250 employees and which have an annual turnover not exceeding EUR 50 million or an annual balance sheet total not exceeding EUR 43 million, until 1 January 2035.
